titleEn: Minimum Speed to Arrive on Time
title: 准时到达的列车最小时速
summary: 各段列车只能整点发车，末段到站无需等待，求在给定小时内到达的最小整数时速。
insight: 速度越快，总时间越短，具有单调性。二分速度；前 n-1 段用向上取整的整数小时，末段保留小数。
pitfalls: hour 小于等于 n-1 时必定无解

solutions.title: 二分最小可行速度
solutions.idea: 在速度的单调可行区间中找左边界。
steps: 检查前 n-1 段 ceil(dist/speed)，末段直接除；可行时收缩右端

code.java: class Solution { private boolean can(int[] dist,double hour,int speed){double used=0;for(int i=0;i<dist.length-1;i++)used+=(dist[i]+speed-1)/speed;used+=(double)dist[dist.length-1]/speed;return used<=hour;}public int minSpeedOnTime(int[] dist,double hour){if(hour<=dist.length-1)return -1;int left=1,right=10_000_000;while(left<right){int middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(can(dist,hour,middle))right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return can(dist,hour,left)?left:-1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun can(dist:IntArray,hour:Double,speed:Int):Boolean{var used=0.0;for(i in 0 until dist.lastIndex)used+=(dist[i]+speed-1)/speed;used+=dist.last().toDouble()/speed;return used<=hour};fun minSpeedOnTime(dist:IntArray,hour:Double):Int{if(hour<=dist.size-1)return -1;var left=1;var right=10_000_000;while(left<right){val middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(can(dist,hour,middle))right=middle else left=middle+1};return if(can(dist,hour,left))left else -1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool can(vector<int>& dist,double hour,int speed){double used=0;for(int i=0;i+1<(int)dist.size();++i)used+=(dist[i]+speed-1)/speed;used+=(double)dist.back()/speed;return used<=hour;}public: int minSpeedOnTime(vector<int>& dist,double hour){if(hour<=dist.size()-1)return -1;int left=1,right=10000000;while(left<right){int middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(can(dist,hour,middle))right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return can(dist,hour,left)?left:-1;} };
